Every free pair, maximal critical deletion, and complete reversed-Hasse DAG is rechecked. Integral unit-pivot chain elimination gives zero Morse differentials, including the mixed link. Graph automorphisms give two exhaustive 12-edge orbits. The standard matching deletion-link cofiber X/Y≃ΣL and integral long exact sequences give a primitive split rank36 injection for C3 direction and a rank42 map with free rank2 kernel/cokernel for C4 direction. Actual standalone verifier passed in this package; finite assertions are exhaustive, not extrapolations.

value.rationale: The exact link/cofiber distinction shows that a C4-direction missing edge produces a nonisomorphism on H3 despite equal objectwise homotopy types, while a C3-direction missing edge kills eight free generators by a primitive quotient. These two natural edge orbits of the same four-regular toroidal graph motivate the precise homology map rather than a merely renamed or arbitrary slice. The result is a checkable benchmark for topological edge-fault robustness with mathematical content beyond a Betti-number table.
